context: Grading a diagnostic script and incident report for a GitHub Copilot default model that suddenly stopped responding.

checklist.name: api_query_for_status
checklist.description: diagnose.sh queries the GitHub Copilot API directly (via fetch-models.sh or curl) to check the target model's status, not relying on `opencode models` output.

checklist.name: policy_state_checked
checklist.description: Script inspects policy.state for the affected model to determine whether it is active.

checklist.name: auth_verification_step
checklist.description: Script includes a step to verify auth token validity.

checklist.name: registry_staleness_noted
checklist.description: The incident report or script explicitly states that OpenCode's model list may be stale and should not be trusted as definitive.

checklist.name: replacement_model_found
checklist.description: Script discovers and outputs at least one alternative enabled model as a suggested replacement.

checklist.name: root_cause_in_report
checklist.description: incident-report.md identifies the root cause as a model policy change (disabled/deprecated), not a generic unknown error.
